evidence_class: Scoped fixture launch grants from LaunchAuthority, fakeredis, fixture clock, stored runtime observations; no live rollout. Live G3 qualification is separate.
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.reconciliation.accounts.AccountReconciler.report(): read-only findings for this swarm's account rows and live fleet sessions

AccountReconciler.reconcile(): releases only expired reservations, ended sessions, lost classifications of the row's own generation and retiring rows whose successor occupancy is confirmed; every other case is kept and reported; writes account_occupancy_discrepancies per swarm

AccountReconciler.exited(execution_id, generation, source): releases only on the stored supervisor exit or a Kubernetes Succeeded or Failed phase of that exact generation; other sources are insufficient_evidence; a replaced generation is stale_exit
scripts.swarm_v2.reconciliation.accounts.page(store, slug) and the account_reconciliation block of scripts.swarm.status.status_report

scripts.swarm_v2.accounts.AccountCapacity.reserve keeps a replaced generation's live occupancy as a retiring row; reconstruct seats the newest live record per seat and older live ones as retiring rows; AccountCapacity.rows, drop; retiring, seat_holder, stored_accounts

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards passed in the linked CI run
supported_versions.coordination: SV2-CTL launch grants, execution generations, SV2-ACC-01 fleet registry records, SV2-ACC-02 account rows, SV2-KUB runtime observations
supported_versions.compatibility: AGENTIHOOKS_ACCOUNT_RECONCILE=observe reports releases as observe_only and frees nothing; local-backend sessions are not reported as unaccounted

states.observed: Account rows, registry records, fleet session records and stored runtime observations
states.accepted: A finding whose classification names release evidence for the row's own execution and generation
states.committed: AccountCapacity.drop removes only rows byte-equal to the judged ones in a Redis WATCH/MULTI transaction
states.externally_verified: None; no controller calls reconcile in a live launch yet

validation.unit: All Python unit shards on 3.11 and 3.12 passed; 35 reconciliation test ids, PASSED on both versions, none failed

validation.review: Standards and Spec readers closed after three rounds; the missing controller caller is a ledger follow-up
validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran; static prepush passed on every pushed head

measurements.dimension: Each test has its own fakeredis store built from account-reconciliation.json; counts are per swarm and kind

rollback_rehearsal.action: AGENTIHOOKS_ACCOUNT_RECONCILE=observe: reconcile and exited report every release as observe_only and free nothing, so caps stay conservative; unsetting it lets the next enforcing pass release
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: Account rows, registry records and session records are authoritative; observe mode deletes nothing and the reconciler never writes registry or session state

remaining_limitations: No production caller runs reconcile or exited yet; calling them at controller start and on the tick is a ledger follow-up. The package stays incomplete until that path runs
account_occupancy_discrepancies is stored in Redis and shown in status; no metric exporter emits it
A missing Pod waits for the lost classification rather than freeing a slot from one not found reading

plan_mapping.sequence_1_compare_reservations_with_exe: AccountReconciler.report and reconcile judge every account row against the execution registry, fleet session records and stored runtime observations
plan_mapping.sequence_2_waiting_quota_distinct_from_t: a waiting_quota worker keeps its slot and is no discrepancy; only a closed session is ended_session
plan_mapping.sequence_3_orphan_occupancy_needs_classi: release only on expiry, closed session, a lost classification of the row's own generation, or a stored exit of that generation
plan_mapping.output_contract_old_slot_after_successor: AccountCapacity.reserve keeps the replaced generation's live occupancy as a retiring row; reconcile releases it only once the successor occupies; this and the rows and drop primitives the reconciler writes through are the only changes to scripts.swarm_v2.accounts
plan_mapping.rejection_contract_ssh_failure_frees_not: exited refuses terminal, heartbeat, provider and ssh sources with insufficient_evidence; reserve refuses the duplicate with account_full
plan_mapping.recovery_contract_restart_without_proces: a restarted reconciler releases expired reservations and keeps live occupancy; reconstruct seats retiring rows; no process table or environment is read

phase_use: Tier 4 launches Anton workers under fleet account caps (SV2-ACC-02). The controller that issues those launch grants calls reconcile at start and on its tick and exited on supervisor or Kubernetes exit events, so crashed or handed-off workers neither leak a slot nor free one early; the swarm status report already shows the reconciliation block. The caller itself is a ledger follow-up, as recorded under remaining_limitations.
